response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM r WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.arcref, r.fundflux, r.rate, r.rate - b.bench AS gap FROM r, b WHERE r.rate > b.bench ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
